name: Microsoft Teams
label: Microsoft Teams — Microsoft Graph v1.0 Teams
description: Microsoft Teams via the official Microsoft Graph v1.0 Teams. Base https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/teams-api-overview. Graph v1.0. Sending channel/chat messages requires delegated ChannelMessage.Send / ChatMessage.Send. Planner update-task/delete-task send If-Match: {if_match} from INPUT if_match (the task @odata.etag from get-task). listen / send-and-wait are BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Microsoft Teams operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"create-channel"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: create-channel | get-channel | list-channels | update-channel | delete-channel | create-channel-message | list-channel-messages | create-chat-message | get-chat-message | list-chat-messages | create-task | get-task | list-tasks | update-task | delete-task | send-and-wait | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: team_id
schema.description: Team id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: channel_id
schema.description: Channel id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: chat_id
schema.description: Chat id (does not create the chat). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: message_id
schema.description: Chat message id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: displayName
schema.description: Channel display name. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: planId
schema.description: Planner plan id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Task title. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Planner task id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: if_match
schema.description: Planner concurrency token for update-task and delete-task. Pass the task @odata.etag from get-task as-is (including W/"..."). Sent as If-Match. A 412 means the etag is stale — GET again. Purpose: operation input.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Request-body parameter `description` for operations: create-channel, update-channel.

schema.label: membershipType
schema.description: create-channel only. EXACT: standard | private | unknownFutureValue. Default standard.

schema.label: body
schema.description:
Graph chatMessage.body {contentType, content}, required by create-channel-message and create-chat-message. contentType EXACT: text | html. Example: {"contentType":"html","content":"

Hi

"}.

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Channel-message subject (create-channel-message). Chat messages ignore subject. Example: Standup notes.

schema.label: bucketId
schema.description: Request-body parameter `bucketId` for operation: create-task.

schema.label: assignments
schema.description: Planner assignments map for create-task / update-task. Keys are user ids; value {"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.plannerAssignment","orderHint":" !"}.

schema.label: percentComplete
schema.description: Planner percentComplete 0–100 for update-task. Example: 50.

schema.label: $top
schema.description: Page size for list-channel-messages and list-chat-messages. Positive integer, Graph max 50. Example: 20.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: create-channel, get-channel, list-channels, update-channel, delete-channel, create-channel-message, list-channel-messages, create-chat-message, get-chat-message, list-chat-messages, create-task, get-task, list-tasks, update-task, delete-task, send-and-wait, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Graph access token
configurationParameters.description: Microsoft Graph access token. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: team_id
configurationParameters.description: Default team id when input omits team_id.

configurationParameters.label: chat_id
configurationParameters.description: Default chat id when input omits chat_id.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Graph Client State
configurationParameters.description: Microsoft Graph subscription clientState verified in constant time against inbound notification value[*].clientState. Never logged.
